title: Document durable task-sync heads and holds separately from rebuildable projections
outcome: Make SQLite and migration operator documentation list new task-sync/feed tables and their actual conversion requirements.
acceptance: sqlite-store.md lists work_task_sync_import_heads and work_task_sync_reconciliation_holds as durable, and work_project_feed_tasks/work_task_sync_baseline/work_task_sync_baseline_heads/work_task_sync_reconciliation_active by their actual rebuildable class
full-store-migration.md accurately describes strict refusal/conversion requirements for stores with import-origin tasks; it never promises an unimplemented head conversion
